summary: Enhance niko-studio's writing analysis with principles from 54 writing craft books, 4 suspense learning paths, and 5 volumes of Chinese web novel trend research. Three tasks: enhance suspense-analyzer with Bell/蔡骏/爽点 methods, create reader-satisfaction-analyzer for web novel optimization, enhance foreshadowing with fair-play rules and information asymmetry.
approach: Three tasks in two waves. Wave 1 enhances suspense-analyzer and creates reader-satisfaction-analyzer (parallel, independent). Wave 2 enhances foreshadowing (uses concepts from both Wave 1 tasks). All changes are additive extensions to existing modules.

waves.label: Core Enhancement
waves.rationale: Parallel — suspense enhancement and reader satisfaction are independent

waves.label: Foreshadow Enhancement
waves.rationale: Uses information asymmetry concepts from both Wave 1 tasks

data_flow.diagram:
chapters → [suspense-analyzer+] → structure_score + satisfaction_density
              → [reader-satisfaction-analyzer] → hook_score + rhythm_score
              → [foreshadowing+] → fair_play_score + info_asymmetry
stages: Enhanced suspense-analyzer checks Bell三幕结构, 蔡骏设局-解局, and 爽点密度 alongside existing Frey pillars
New reader-satisfaction-analyzer provides 爽点密度检测, 章节钩子评分, and 期待-延迟-释放节奏分析
Enhanced foreshadowing adds 公平线索规则, 信息不对称度, and 兑现间隔建议

design_decisions.decision: Extend existing suspense-analyzer rather than create separate structure checker
design_decisions.reason: Suspense and structure are tightly coupled — Bell三幕 integrates with Frey pillars naturally

design_decisions.decision: Create new reader-satisfaction-analyzer as standalone module
design_decisions.reason: Reader satisfaction is a distinct concern from suspense analysis, especially for web novels

design_decisions.decision: Enhance foreshadowing in Wave 2 rather than Wave 1
design_decisions.reason: Information asymmetry scoring benefits from suspense and satisfaction patterns defined first
